apps.label: AI agents
apps.description: Program names, separated by commas. While one of them runs, closing the lid does not suspend the laptop. A script run by node, bun or python counts by its own name or its npm package

ignore.label: Ignore command lines containing
ignore.description: Parts of a command line, separated by commas, that make a process a helper rather than an agent at work. Claude Code's browser bridge runs for as long as Chrome does

battery_floor.label: Battery floor
battery_floor.description: Percent at which Stammgast lets go on battery, so the laptop suspends as usual. It holds again 5 points higher or on mains power. It always lets go at 5 %, whatever this says

lock_on_close.label: Lock when the lid closes
lock_on_close.description: Locks the screen when the lid closes while Stammgast holds it open, as a suspend would have

screen_off_on_close.label: Screen off when the lid closes
screen_off_on_close.description: Turns the screens off when the lid closes while Stammgast holds it open; opening the lid turns them back on

show_projects.label: Show projects
show_projects.description: Show each agent's project, session name, model and cost. Turn off for a copy on the lock screen

show_limits.label: Show usage limits
show_limits.description: Show the usage limits Claude Code and Codex report. Claude's need the status line set up (see the README)
